overview: R-Zero proposes a fully autonomous co-evolutionary framework where a Challenger generates difficulty-calibrated questions and a Solver learns from them via GRPO, enabling self-evolving reasoning LLMs without any human-curated tasks or labels.

modules.name: Configuration Management & Experiment Setup
modules.description: Centralized management of all hyperparameters (GRPO settings, filtering thresholds, repetition penalty scaling, rollout parameters, learning rates, KL penalties), prompt templates for Challenger and Solver, benchmark specifications, and experiment configuration inheritance for reproducibility across model scales and iterations.

modules.name: GRPO Algorithm Core Implementation
modules.description: Implementation of the Group Relative Policy Optimization algorithm including group-wise z-score normalized advantage computation, clipped surrogate objective, and KL-divergence penalty against the old policy, serving as the foundational RL optimizer for both Challenger and Solver training stages.

modules.name: Solver Model & Multi-Sample Rollout Infrastructure
modules.description: Solver model initialization from base LLM, multi-response sampling with configurable temperature and top-p for majority voting and uncertainty estimation, and batched inference support for generating multiple candidate answers per question during both training and dataset construction phases.

modules.name: Challenger Uncertainty Reward Computation
modules.description: Computation of the uncertainty reward signal r_uncertainty = 1 - 2|p̂(x;Sφ) - 1/2|, which maximizes reward when the Solver's empirical accuracy approaches 50%, querying the frozen Solver for m responses, computing the most frequent response as pseudo-label, and deriving the empirical correctness p̂ to evaluate question difficulty calibration.

modules.name: Repetition Penalty via BLEU Clustering
modules.description: Intra-batch diversity enforcement through pairwise BLEU score distance computation between generated questions, agglomerative hierarchical clustering with average linkage on the precomputed distance matrix, and assignment of repetition penalty proportional to relative cluster size to discourage semantically redundant question generation.

modules.name: Composite Reward Aggregation for Challenger
modules.description: Integration of the three reward components for Challenger training: format check penalty (zero reward for missing question tags), uncertainty reward, and repetition penalty, combined as max(0, r_uncertainty - r_rep) to produce the final scalar reward for GRPO policy updates.

modules.name: Pseudo-label Generation & Majority Voting
modules.description: Construction of pseudo-labels for self-generated questions by sampling m responses from the current Solver, determining the most frequent response via majority vote, and computing empirical correctness p̂ for downstream filtering and reward computation, with support for extracting boxed final answers.

modules.name: Task Filtering & Curriculum Construction
modules.description: Difficulty-based dataset curation that retains only question-answer pairs where the Solver's empirical correctness falls within an informative band |p̂_i - 1/2| ≤ δ, simultaneously discarding trivially easy problems, impossibly hard problems, and implicitly filtering out ambiguous or ill-posed questions with low answer consistency.

modules.name: Challenger Training Loop
modules.description: End-to-end Challenger training phase that alternates between question generation rollouts, composite reward computation (uncertainty + repetition + format), and GRPO policy updates, with the Solver frozen during this phase and checkpoints saved for dataset construction.

modules.name: Solver Training Loop
modules.description: End-to-end Solver training phase using GRPO on the curated dataset of challenging question-pseudo-label pairs, with binary verifiable rewards (1 if answer matches pseudo-label, 0 otherwise) and the Challenger frozen during this phase.

modules.name: Co-evolution Iteration Orchestrator
modules.description: Top-level loop controller that manages the iterative co-evolutionary cycle: Challenger training → dataset construction → Solver training, handling model checkpoint freezing/unfreezing across iterations, tracking iteration number, and coordinating the self-evolving curriculum across multiple rounds.

modules.name: Math Benchmark Evaluation with GPT-4o Judge
modules.description: Evaluation on mathematical reasoning benchmarks (AMC, Minerva, MATH-500, GSM8K, OlympiadBench, AIME-2024, AIME-2025) using greedy decoding for most benchmarks and mean@32 for AMC/AIME, with GPT-4o as a programmatic judge for semantic verification of complex mathematical answers against ground truth.

modules.name: General Domain Reasoning Evaluation
modules.description: Evaluation on general-domain reasoning benchmarks (MMLU-Pro, SuperGPQA, BBEH) using greedy decoding with Exact Match accuracy, testing whether math-focused self-evolving training transfers reasoning capabilities to broader domains.

modules.name: Ablation Study Framework
modules.description: Controlled ablation experiments that systematically disable core components—repetition penalty removal, task filtering removal, and parameter sharing between Challenger and Solver vs. separate models—to isolate each component's contribution to overall performance on math and general benchmarks.

modules.name: Iteration Scaling & Performance Degradation Analysis
modules.description: Longitudinal analysis across multiple co-evolution iterations for different model scales (0.6B, 1.7B, 4B, 8B), tracking peak performance timing, performance collapse patterns, and the correlation between model capacity and resilience to degradation, with checkpoint evaluation at regular step intervals.

modules.name: Supervised Data Synergy Experiments
modules.description: Evaluation of R-Zero as a mid-training method by comparing three strategies: R-Zero only, supervised fine-tuning only, and sequential R-Zero followed by SFT, plus a concurrent mixed training variant, to validate that co-evolutionary pre-training provides a superior initialization for downstream labeled-data fine-tuning.

modules.name: Question Difficulty & Pseudo-label Quality Tracking
modules.description: Analysis of the co-evolutionary dynamics by sampling questions from each iteration, evaluating their intrinsic difficulty against a fixed model, and measuring pseudo-label accuracy against an external oracle (GPT-4o), tracking the progressive increase in question difficulty and the systematic decline in pseudo-label reliability across iterations.

modules.name: Result Aggregation & Report Generation
modules.description: Automated aggregation of evaluation results across all benchmarks, model scales, and iterations; generation of comparison tables matching the paper's format (math reasoning, general-domain reasoning, ablation results, synergy experiments, difficulty/accuracy analysis); and visualization of iteration scaling curves with peak performance markers.
